name: Gridstack.js · Nested grids demo

title.zh: Gridstack.js · 从嵌套网格范例看父子结构

description.zh: 父网格与编号子网格 Gridstack.js 为应用提供可拖拽、调整尺寸和响应式重排的网格布局，官网还介绍跨网格移动、嵌套网格及保存恢复。示例目录按布局和框架列出具体演示；Nested grids 图完整显示父网格、两个子网格、编号项目与增删和保存控件。它适合作为仪表盘编辑区域的复合布局控件，图中的默认状态不代表所有拖拽行为都已实测。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Gridstack.js (https://gridstackjs.com/).
Technology stack: typescript, javascript, angular, react.
Component specification: 父网格与编号子网格


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
